info.title: Agent Task Manager
info.description: Task board, agent runs and their artifacts. Every operation is scoped to the workspace its credential belongs to.

get.summary: List tasks, optionally by status or project
Get a task with its project and live run

post.summary: Move a task to another status
Reorder a task within its column

put.summary: Choose the session the next run uses

post.summary: Post a comment on a task

get.summary: Read a page of a run's events
Stream a run's events as they happen
List the intents queued on a task

post.summary: Ask the orchestrator to stop a run
Ask the orchestrator to rerun a task
Ask the orchestrator to start a session
Upload an artifact into a task's folder
Promote an artifact to the project or globally

get.summary: Get a conversation with its live turn

patch.summary: Retitle, select or archive a conversation

get.summary: Read a page of a conversation

post.summary: Post a message to a conversation
Ask the orchestrator to stop a live turn

readToken.description: Bearer token scoped to reads. Every GET in this API accepts it.

sessionCookie.description: Better Auth browser session. The dashboard's credential; machines use a bearer token.
sessionCookie.name: better-auth.session_token

userApiKey.description: An API key a person issued for themselves. It acts as that person, with the scope chosen when it was created, and stops working the moment it is revoked.
userApiKey.name: x-api-key

taskWriteToken.description: Bearer token scoped to writes. A run's token is bound to its own task and is refused on any other.

adminToken.description: Bearer token scoped to destructive operations and to stored secrets — deleting a project, and a project's environment files.

tags.name: projects
tags.description: Projects: repositories, areas of life, and the environment files a project's runs are given.

tags.name: tasks
tags.description: Tasks: the board, and the moves a card can make on it.

tags.name: sessions
tags.description: Agent sessions: one conversation each, and the transcript it left.

tags.name: runs

tags.name: runCommands
tags.description: Run commands: stop, rerun and start-session, queued for the orchestrator.

tags.name: artifacts
tags.description: Artifacts: files a run kept, and the promotion that shares them.

tags.name: threads
tags.description: Threads: conversations with the manager agent, and the turns they cause.
